spans.s: कु f. 1. The earth; 2. the base of a triangle or any plain figure.

कु ind. A prefix implying ‘depreciation,’ ‘badness,’ ‘sin,’ ‘reproach,’ ‘contempt.’ (In many places, it assumes the forms कद्, (e.g. कदश्व), कव, (e.g. कवोष्ण), का, (e.g. कापुरुष), किम्, (e.g. किंसखि).
कु (II) vi. 6Ā (pres. कुवते) To moan, to groan.
कु (III) vi. 2P (pres. कौति) To hum, to coo.
कू vi. 6Ā, 9U (pres. कुवते, कुनाति, कुनीते) To sound, to make noise, to cry in distress, क्रूराश्चाकूषत द्विजाः Bt.xv.26.
